newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse trade suspended on technical hitch. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: German bourse trade suspended on technical hitch. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]

text.p: All German floor trade in equities, bonds and derivatives was temporarily suspended at midday on Wednesday due to massive system problems, a bourse spokesman said. (Corrects to clarify that floor trading rather than all trading was suspended.)
The bourse added however that trade on the DTB futures exchange had continued undisturbed.
"All trading in Frankfurt and the nation's regional bourses has been temporarily suspended due to system problems," a bourse spokesman told Reuters.

Trading ground to a halt shortly after noon as the bond market and the share market were both racing higher. Today's shutdown was the second time this week that bourse trading was interrupted due to technical problems.
IBIS computer trade was stopped for 90 minutes and the opening of bourse floor trade was delayed for about two hours due to computer network problems on Monday.
